# OpenJoystickDriver

> macOS userspace gamepad driver. The signed app reads physical controllers, parses native reports, and publishes virtual HID for games, emulators, SDL apps, and native macOS apps.

The same binary is the CLI. Ground support claims in source, tests, schemas, or recorded hardware evidence. Do not copy the compatibility matrix here.

Do not edit generated controller records or `.build/driverkit/generated/`. `OpenJoystickDriverKit` must not import SwifterKit. The host user-client entitlement allowlists only `com.openjoystickdriver.XboxUSBDevice`. The virtual-device entitlement stays on the app, never the DriverKit extension.
